newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European bunkers firm $4-$5, many shorts to cover.
newsitem.headline: European bunkers firm $4-$5, many shorts to cover.

text.p: European fuel oil bunker prices were up around $4 a tonne on Tuesday, causing light covering in the north and some heavy trade in parts of the Mediterranean.
Rotterdam 380 CST bunkers traded in a range from $109 to $114 fob in a relatively active morning. Later quotes were around $112/$113.
"There were quite a number of enquiries this morning. People needed to get a few things done with this Iraqi business. Then they just sat back," one dealer said.
Hamburg prices were about $3 higher than in Rotterdam. Similar essential short covering made morning trading busy.
In some areas, short-covering led to a hectic morning, but confident players elsewhere preferred to wait another week before buying.
Some said buyers who needed to cover traded one port off against another to optimise the price.
Spanish trading was the busiest. French, Italian and Greek bunkering was slight.
Further east, Suez and Alexandria saw healthier trading than for most of the last month.
